name: Rokuya Nagi
source:
Nagi has remarkably good looks and high charisma. He is often seen flirting with women and is a great fan of anime. Despite his looks, Nagi was lonely as he didn't have many friends growing up. Due to this, he treasures and loves the members of IDOLiSH7 very much. He is often the one who tries to bring the group together when there is a conflict among the group. He is also good at fighting and can speak fluently in many languages. 

[Taken from [url=https://idolish7.miraheze.org/wiki/Nagi_Rokuya]IDOLiSH7 Wiki[/url]]
